Grizzly_Intense_Eyes.description: Brimming with primal ferocity, the Grizzly Intense Eyes are a haunting visage of amber and shadow, granting the beholder an unparalleled sense of awareness and a menacing presence that can strike fear into the hearts of foes.

Polar_Bear_Dark_Eyes.description: With dark, piercing eyes that seem to absorb the light around them, this polar bear's gaze grants an innate resilience to the biting cold and a heightened perception of its surroundings, making it a formidable presence in the frozen wastes.

Black_Bear_Curious_Eyes.description: The Black Bear Curious Eyes, a mystical enhancement that grants the beholder an uncanny perception, allowing them to see in the darkest of nights and sense the faintest tremors beneath their feet, imbuing them with the agility and keen senses of an ursine predator.

Panda_Sorrowful_Eyes.description: Set deep within the sorrowful gaze of this ursine cephalon are eyes that pierce the soul with an ancient wisdom and melancholic beauty, granting the bearer unparalleled charisma and the ability to charm and confuse enemies with a single glance.

Sun_Bear_Keen_Eyes.description: The Sun Bear's keen eyes, a marvel of Ursine evolution, pierce the veil of shadows with an uncanny clarity, granting the beholder a heightened perception that rivals the sharpest senses of the forest's apex predators.

Sloth_Bear_Poor_Eyesight.description: This Ursine entity bears the mark of a celestial curse, its once piercing eyes now dim and clouded, severely hampering its perception of the world around it. Yet, in a paradoxical twist, the very burden of its poor sight has forged an unyielding endurance, its constitution fortified by the trials of navigating a blurry and unforgiving realm.

Spectacled_Bear_Masked_Eyes.description: Brimming with the essence of the forest's ancient guardians, the Spectacled_Bear_Masked_Eyes component is a cephalon graft that bestows upon its bearer the enhanced vision and heightened perception of a spectacled bear, allowing for perfect camouflage and an uncanny ability to sense approaching danger.

Cave_Bear_Small_Deep_Eyes.description: Embedded deep within the skull of a sub-adult cave bear, these eyes, a dark and luminous void, grant an eerie clarity in the darkest of environments, enhancing the creature's perception and resilience against piercing attacks, a testament to their heavy, robust nature.

Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Sockets.description: The Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Sockets, with its hollow eye sockets oozing a sickly green pus and emitting a faint, eerie glow, epitomizes the decaying nature of the undead. Its once piercing gaze now serves only to drain the spirits of those who dare meet its gaze, while its weakened senses make it a blundering, yet relentless predator in the eternal twilight of the necrotic forest.

Spirit_Bear_Glowing_Eyes.description: The Spirit Bear Glowing Eyes, a spectral visage with an ethereal glow, grants its bearer enhanced wisdom and perception, enabling them to see in darkness and detect magical auras, traits reminiscent of an otherworldly creature that straddles the line between life and undeath.
